The referenced text is ---------, Load. The title's vertical position comes from a count of entries, capped at nine.

name: draw_fixed_panel_frame
description: Sets the drawing colour, fills a fixed-size rectangle at the origin, then draws a bordered panel outline at fixed coordinates through library calls.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a3]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a3].adf:BattleChess:0:1079E
name: draw_menu_labels
description: Sets a drawing colour and draws three fixed text labels from a data table, adding a fourth label only when its argument is nonzero.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a3]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a3].adf:BattleChess:0:10806
name: draw_cancel_done_buttons
description: Draws the Cancel and Done button labels through library text calls, adding an extra fixed-length string when the argument is nonzero. The referenced text is Cancel, Done.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a3]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a3].adf:BattleChess:0:108A2
name: draw_box_from_corner_coords
description: Builds a three-coordinate set from a source pair and passes it to a drawing helper with a mode of 5, after calling a library routine with the first two coordinates.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a3]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a3].adf:BattleChess:0:1091A
name: open_ui_window_or_fail
description: Stores a value in a global word, then calls a library routine that opens a window from a prepared structure and keeps the returned handle. It reports the referenced text unable to open a window. when the handle is zero and returns whether the window opened.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a3]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a3].adf:BattleChess:0:10948
name: return_true_constant
description: Returns the constant 1 without doing any other work.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a3]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a3].adf:BattleChess:0:10966
name: close_ui_window_if_open
description: If a window handle is stored, closes that window through a library call, makes a second library call with fixed values, and clears the stored handle to zero. It then calls a helper.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a3]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a3].adf:BattleChess:0:1099C
name: copy_block_resource_or_fallback
description: Fills a 32-byte stack structure through a helper, then requests a resource with a fixed identifier from a library. On success it copies 512 bytes from the argument into that resource and releases it; otherwise it calls a library routine with the argument and a fixed mask.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a3]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a3].adf:BattleChess:0:109D6
name: run_library_call_return_true
description: Calls a library routine and a helper with no arguments, then returns the constant 1.

name: write_block_if_resource_found
description: Fills a 32-byte stack structure through a helper, and calls a helper first when a flag word is zero. It then requests a resource with a second fixed identifier; when the resource exists, it copies 512 bytes from the argument into it and releases it. Returns whether the resource was found.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a3]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a3].adf:BattleChess:0:10A26
name: run_two_helpers_return_true
description: Calls two helpers with no arguments and returns the constant 1.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a3]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a3].adf:BattleChess:0:10A44
name: initialise_saves_name_buffer
description: Clears the first byte of its buffer. When a flag word is zero it calls a helper with the buffer and the address of a global word, then calls a helper. It then calls a helper again with the same buffer and global address. The referenced text includes ChessSaves and ChessSaves:.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a3]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a3].adf:BattleChess:0:10A90
name: initialise_request_struct_and_call
description: Zeroes the first two words of a request structure, sets two mode bytes, clears a field and stores the argument and a third value into it, then passes the structure and a second argument to a helper.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a3]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a3].adf:BattleChess:0:10AE4
name: setup_serial_receive_interrupt
description: Creates a buffer through a library call, stores its pointers in two fields, sets the receive-buffer-full bit in the interrupt-request register, enables that interrupt through the set-bit convention, and programs the serial period register with a fixed divisor.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a3]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a3].adf:BattleChess:0:10B26
name: send_serial_byte_run
description: Writes a counted run of bytes to the serial data register with bit 8 set on each byte, polling the transmit-buffer-empty status bit before each write.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a3]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a3].adf:BattleChess:0:10B4A
name: send_serial_bytes_from_pointer
description: Writes bytes from a moving pointer to the serial data register with bit 8 set, polling the transmit-buffer-empty status bit before each byte, until the remaining count reaches zero.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a3]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a3].adf:BattleChess:0:10B5E
name: return_nothing
description: Returns immediately without doing any work.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a3]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a3].adf:BattleChess:0:10B66
name: receive_serial_bytes_with_timeout
description: Copies bytes from a receive ring buffer into the caller's buffer, polling a timer-like counter for each byte. It returns zero when the requested count has been copied and minus one when the timer expires first.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a3]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a3].adf:BattleChess:0:10BB0
name: receive_serial_bytes_wrap_ring
description: Copies bytes out of the receive ring buffer and wraps the read pointer back to the start when it passes the end. It returns minus one when a remaining-space check fails and zero once the requested length is exhausted.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a3]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a3].adf:BattleChess:0:10BDE
name: return_negative_one
description: Returns minus one with no other work.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a3]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a3].adf:BattleChess:0:10BE8
name: receive_serial_bytes_into_frame
description: Reads bytes from the receive ring into its stack frame, polling for each byte against a timeout of eight counter units. It returns zero once the requested count has been read and minus one when the timeout expires.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a3]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a3].adf:BattleChess:0:10BEA
name: return_zero_value
description: Returns zero with no other work.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a3]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a3].adf:BattleChess:0:10BEE
name: discard_pending_receive_bytes
description: Sets the receive read pointer equal to the write pointer, discarding any unread bytes in the receive ring.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a3]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a3].adf:BattleChess:0:10BFC
name: count_pending_receive_bytes
description: Returns the number of bytes waiting in the receive ring, computed from the write and read pointers and adding the ring size of 128 when the write pointer is behind the read pointer.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a3]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a3].adf:BattleChess:0:10C1E
name: compute_receive_ring_distance
description: Returns the distance between a stored position and the receive read pointer, wrapped by a ring size of 128 when the read pointer is behind.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a3]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a3].adf:BattleChess:0:10C36
name: disable_serial_receive_interrupt
description: Writes the receive-buffer-full bit to the interrupt-enable register without the set flag, which disables that interrupt, then calls a library routine with a fixed index of 11 and the stored handle.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a3]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a3].adf:BattleChess:0:10C54
name: enqueue_serial_transmit_byte
description: Stores a value in a request field, writes one byte from that field into the transmit ring buffer, advances the write pointer and wraps it at the end of the ring.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a3]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a3].adf:BattleChess:0:10C7E
name: send_checksummed_packet
description: Sums the payload bytes into two alternating check bytes, prefixes the packet with a space and a zero, and sends the packet through the serial library. It then loops on a reply check, returning once the reply is no longer minus one. The check uses a fixed signature value when the reply fails.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a3]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a3].adf:BattleChess:0:10CAC
name: accumulate_checksum_bytes_then_send
description: Accumulates a byte sequence into two alternating check bytes, sends the result through the serial library, then waits for a reply. When the reply is minus one it sends a fixed signature value instead.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a3]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a3].adf:BattleChess:0:10D08
name: parse_link_packet_header
description: Checks the first byte of a link packet against two packet markers, reading up to four further bytes and retrying a step when a read fails. An unknown marker or an overlong packet is reported through a library call with a fixed message identifier.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a3]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a3].adf:BattleChess:0:10D2C
name: handle_link_send_collision
description: Reads a link packet marker and up to four following bytes, retrying on read failures. When the marker is unexpected it reports the referenced text Sending at the same time...try again through a library call.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a3]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a3].adf:BattleChess:0:10D4C
name: wait_for_link_reply
description: Waits for a reply packet over the link for up to four attempts, writing a fixed signature word whenever a read times out. If no valid reply arrives it reports the referenced text Opponent not responding.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a3]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a3].adf:BattleChess:0:10DBA
name: receive_and_verify_link_frame
description: Reads one link frame: a marker byte from the 160 class, a length byte limited to seven bits and at most 40 body bytes, then accumulates two alternating check bytes over the body and compares them with the received check bytes.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a3]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a3].adf:BattleChess:0:10E42
name: match_link_frame_header
description: Accumulates two alternating check bytes over the frame body, then compares the next two bytes with the expected marker pair. On a match, a frame of type 166 sends one of two fixed signature words, chosen by a stored flag.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a3]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a3].adf:BattleChess:0:10E72
name: run_link_receive_session
description: Runs the link session loop: it clears a stored state byte, polls the link status and parses incoming bytes into frames until a read times out, returning minus one in that case.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a3]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a3].adf:BattleChess:0:10E7A
name: send_sync_word_and_receive
description: Writes one of two fixed sync words, chosen by a stored flag, to the link and then runs the same receive loop as the session routine.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a3]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a3].adf:BattleChess:0:10E88
name: send_fixed_sync_then_receive
description: Writes the first fixed sync word without consulting the stored flag, then runs the same receive loop as its siblings.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a3]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a3].adf:BattleChess:0:10EA2
name: return_zero_value_stub
description: Returns zero with no other work. It is a stub with no memory access.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a3]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a3].adf:BattleChess:0:10EAC
name: dispatch_link_command_code
description: Handles a link command code. Code 166 sends one of two fixed signature words chosen by a stored flag, code 170 sets a stored flag, and any other code returns zero. It then continues with the receive loop.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a3]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a3].adf:BattleChess:0:10EBA
name: receive_link_text_or_packet
description: Polls the link and retries up to a fixed count before returning minus one. Bytes below 128 are treated as text, accumulated up to a carriage return with non-printable characters replaced, while bytes from the 160 class start a packet that is handed to the header parser.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a3]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a3].adf:BattleChess:0:10EC6
name: receive_link_message_resetting_state
description: Sets a stored state byte to 1 and then runs the same receive loop as its siblings, returning minus one when the retries run out.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a3]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a3].adf:BattleChess:0:10ED2
name: receive_link_message_single_retry
description: Runs the receive loop with a single retry, returning minus one when the second read attempt also fails.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a3]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a3].adf:BattleChess:0:10EDA
name: process_modem_response_line
description: Copies a received text line up to a carriage return, replacing characters outside the printable range and terminating the string. Unless the line is the echo string ATE, it is reported through a library call, and reading then continues.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a3]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a3].adf:BattleChess:0:10F12
name: send_modem_command_and_wait
description: Clears a reply byte and reports the received text line unless it is the echo string ATE. It then reads link bytes with a timeout and returns minus one when no response arrives.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a3]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a3].adf:BattleChess:0:10F4C
name: receive_link_packet_body
description: Sets a stored state byte to 1 and waits for a marker byte from the 160 class. It then reads the length byte, limited to 40 body bytes, and the following bytes into a buffer, returning minus one on timeout.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a3]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a3].adf:BattleChess:0:10F62
name: send_probe_message_when_ready
description: When either of two stored status words equals two, builds a two-byte message beginning with 161 and 37 and sends it through a helper using a 38-byte buffer.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a3]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a3].adf:BattleChess:0:10FA6
name: send_addressed_command_packet
description: Builds a four-byte command packet with type 162 and length 6, copies two bytes from the argument's offsets 1 and 3 into it, and sends the packet.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a3]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a3].adf:BattleChess:0:10FEA
name: send_command_169_packet
description: Sends a fixed two-byte command with code 169 and parameter 5.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a3]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a3].adf:BattleChess:0:1101E
name: send_signature_and_clear_flag
description: Sends a fixed four-byte signature word through a helper and then clears a stored status byte to zero.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a3]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a3].adf:BattleChess:0:11040
name: fill_buffer_with_countdown_bytes
description: Writes the counter value as one byte into consecutive buffer positions, counting down from the argument to zero.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a3]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a3].adf:BattleChess:0:11054
name: next_random_word_from_seed
description: Calls a library routine, adds 12345 to its result, stores the sum as the seed and returns the upper 15 bits of the seed.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a3]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a3].adf:BattleChess:0:11088
name: set_random_seed_high_word
description: Stores the upper 16 bits of its argument as the random seed.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a3]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a3].adf:BattleChess:0:1109A
name: convert_to_uppercase
description: Converts a lowercase ASCII letter to uppercase by subtracting 32. Any other byte is returned unchanged.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a3]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a3].adf:BattleChess:0:110B2
name: convert_to_lowercase
description: Converts an uppercase ASCII letter to lowercase by adding 32. Any other byte is returned unchanged.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a3]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a3].adf:BattleChess:0:110CA
name: startup_open_dos_library
description: Clears a large block of longwords in the global area, saves the system library base from a fixed location, and opens dos.library through the library-open call. It raises an alert on failure and uses the Amiga system calls Alert, OldOpenLibrary and Supervisor. The referenced text is dos.library.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a3]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a3].adf:BattleChess:0:1113C
name: empty_return_stub
description: Returns immediately without doing any work.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a3]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a3].adf:BattleChess:0:11144
name: allocate_cleared_port_record
description: Allocates a cleared record array sized by a global count, writes the four-character tag MANX into a node, and links the node into a list. It then finds or creates a port structure, copies a name into it and sends signals through library calls, recording the results in global words.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a3]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a3].adf:BattleChess:0:1127A
name: allocate_argument_string_buffer
description: Computes a buffer size from a table entry plus a length argument, allocates that buffer, copies the source text into it, and passes the buffer to the argument parser.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a3]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a3].adf:BattleChess:0:1127C
name: parse_argument_string_into_vector
description: Copies a quoted or whitespace-delimited string into the buffer, splitting it into separate arguments, and then builds a null-terminated array of pointers to them. It sets the argument count to zero when the pointer array cannot be allocated.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a3]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a3].adf:BattleChess:0:1142C
name: copy_bounded_string_zero_padded
description: Copies bytes from the source until the count is used up or a zero terminator is reached, then writes zeros over the rest of the count. It returns the destination pointer.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a3]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a3].adf:BattleChess:0:1142E
name: copy_string_padded_with_zeros
description: Copies bytes from the source until the count is used up or a zero terminator is reached, then fills the remaining count with zeros. Its code is identical to its sibling that also zero-pads.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a3]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a3].adf:BattleChess:0:11450
name: copy_bytes_handling_overlap
description: Copies a counted block of bytes from source to destination. When the destination lies above the source it copies backwards, so overlapping regions are handled correctly.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a3]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a3].adf:BattleChess:0:1147A
name: append_string_limited
description: Appends the source string to the end of the destination, copying at most 32767 bytes and stopping at the zero terminator.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a3]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a3].adf:BattleChess:0:11480
name: append_string_with_count_limit
description: Appends a source string to the end of the destination under a count limit. If the count runs out before the terminator, it writes a zero terminator at the next destination byte.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a3]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a3].adf:BattleChess:0:114A4
name: compare_byte_strings_limited
description: Compares two zero-terminated byte strings for up to 32767 bytes. It returns zero when they match, minus one when the first differing byte of the first string is smaller or equal, and one otherwise.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a3]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a3].adf:BattleChess:0:114D4
name: copy_string_to_buffer
description: Copies a zero-terminated source string into the destination buffer, including the terminator, and returns the destination pointer.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a3]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a3].adf:BattleChess:0:114E4
name: multiply_words_to_64
description: Combines the cross products of the 16-bit halves of its two arguments into a 32-bit value, returned in the high half of a 64-bit result with the second argument in the low half.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a3]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a3].adf:BattleChess:0:11508
name: open_window_with_icon_library
description: Opens a window through a library call on the global name, then fetches a screen structure from the parameter and opens icon.library. It walks the structure's fields in turn and stores the resulting handle in the parameter block. The referenced texts are WINDOW and icon.library.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a3]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a3].adf:BattleChess:0:115BA
name: create_timer_request_read_time
description: Creates a message port and a timer request structure, opens the timer device, and returns a time value read from the device through a library call.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a3]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a3].adf:BattleChess:0:115BC
name: open_timer_device_or_report
description: Creates a message port and a timer request structure, then opens timer.device. If the device cannot be opened it reports the referenced text timer is not available. It then reads the elapsed time through a library call.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a3]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a3].adf:BattleChess:0:11672
name: perform_signed_division
description: Works out the result sign from the signs of its two arguments, calls a helper to perform the unsigned division, and negates the quotient when the signs differ. It returns the signed quotient in the high half of a 64-bit result with the second argument in the low half.
